title: fix(app-shell): the publish sheet marks an edit to a published container view as Update, not New
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DY4fJ9yvtA1wQ4MMKNiNpgV)_

Fixes #32755

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 发布对话框判断「新增 / 更新」时,视图草稿若不在已发布列表里,会再按名字读一次已发布版本,读到即判「更新」。
- 为什么改:已发布视图列表只列出视图容器展开后的视图,不列容器本身的名字,所以以 `<对象>.default` 存放的表单视图被改动后显示成「新增」,审阅人看不出线上布局即将被改。
- 风险与回滚:只影响发布对话框的标记,只多发一次只读请求(仅限不在列表中的视图草稿);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx` 分类循环中 `type === 'view'` 的分支;其次新测试 `DraftChangesPanel.containerViewUpdate-32755.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.containerViewUpdate-32755.test.tsx`,预期 4 例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`DraftChangesPanel` classifies each pending draft as New or Update from one published-list read per type. For `view`, that list (`GET /api/v1/meta/view`) by contract never enumerates a stored aggregated view container, only the items it expands to (the "Canonical-shape exposure" filter in `readFlattenedMetaItems`). A view stored as a container under its own name, such as `ebqu_claim.default` carrying a `form`, is therefore published yet absent from the list, and its next draft read **New**, with no changed keys in its drill-in.

Now a `view` draft the list does not name asks the by-name published door (`GET /api/v1/meta/view/:name?package=…`), which serves the container row, the same way a bundle member is already classified. Present means Update; 404 means New; a failed read leaves the entry unclassified (neutral), as a failed list read already does. Listed views cost no extra read. Other types are unchanged.

The server half was measured and holds no defect: the list door omits containers by design, and the by-name door answers the container. No `domain:server` carrier is needed.

## Tests

- New `DraftChangesPanel.containerViewUpdate-32755.test.tsx` (4 cases): the container view reads Update and its drill-in lists one changed key, `~ form`; CONTROL: a never-published view draft still reads New; only unlisted views get a by-name read; CONTROL: a failed by-name read leaves the entry unclassified.
- All 26 `DraftChangesPanel*` / preview suites: 174 passed.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (src + test tsconfig): exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Live reading (scratch dogfood probe on `bootStack`, not committed): after drafting and publishing `ebqu_claim.default` = `{ object, label, form }` and drafting a second `form` change, `GET /meta/view` listed only `ebqu_claim.ebqu_claim.default.form`, while `GET /meta/view/ebqu_claim.default` answered 200 with keys `name, object, label, form`. A never-published `ebqu_claim.fresh` answered 404 by name.
- Observation only, not filed: a package-less container stored as `ebqu_claim.default` on a package's object expands under its own name (`<object>.<container name>.form`), so its form is listed as `ebqu_claim.ebqu_claim.default.form`. That is the documented own-name arm for a container on another package's object; it is outside this card.

## Verification

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx --anchor 'published.has(entry.name) || confirmed.has(key)' --replacement 'published.has(entry.name) /* ABLATION-32755 */' -- …vitest run …containerViewUpdate-32755.test.tsx`

- Mutation landed: replacement marker x0 → x1.
- Result: `× classifies the container view as Update and lists its changed form key` · `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`; both CONTROL cases stayed green.
- Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- A first attempt used a replacement that is a substring of the anchor; the tool refused it (count rose by 0) and ran nothing. It is recorded here, not counted.
</details>
